data.one_liner: Provides Flutter Hooks wrappers for Forui widget controllers.
data.what_it_does: Exposes Forui widget controllers as hook functions for use in HookWidget trees. Allows easy state management of Forui components via flutter_hooks. Keeps API parity with the underlying Forui package.
use_when: You are already using Forui and want hook‑based state handling
You prefer declarative hook syntax over manual controller management
avoid_when: You need functionality beyond what Forui provides
weaknesses: Limited to features exposed by Forui
